1) Kamishibai Theatre: a wooden paper-theatre stage (kamishibai) for project case studies. Each project becomes a stack of hand-inked cards that slide out of the stage frame one by one (View Transitions), with clapper-sound cues and an "ink babble" voice: a tiny WebAudio gibberish engine that turns caption text into Animal-Crossing-style speech sounds, with a mute toggle and a reduced-motion fallback to a plain card list. Inspiration: https://x.com/marcel_wiessler/status/2110312537786876177

2) Peep-box Diorama: an opt-in "look inside" mode on the Play page where the scene becomes a layered paper-cutout diorama (Ryugu-jo seabed, fish, kelp, the turtle). With permission, the webcam tracks the visitor's head (MediaPipe face landmarks, all on-device, nothing uploaded) and renders an off-axis perspective so the box feels like a real window; falls back to mouse/gyro parallax. Inspiration: https://x.com/Simone_dev_com/status/2113631529335423305

3) Message in a Bottle: a small corked-bottle button in the footer/Pocket that "washes up" a random hand-picked indie site, browser toy or interactive artwork (curated JSON list with a one-line inked note per link), plus visitors can toss in their own site suggestion to a moderated queue. Inspiration: https://x.com/weirdwebfun/status/2109672294968889612

Keep it on-brand (paper texture, SVG ink filters), lazy-load the heavy bits, respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep the camera strictly opt-in.
